method: Actual renderer: 2898 identical collision probes and 20 identical grounded movement attempts against 15A. Fifteen scene/profile changes, gradual accumulation, mutually exclusive precipitation transitions, three warm resource returns, real audio rain-to-snow transition, missing/corrupt/stale/oversized exposure failures. Diagnostic time stepping is labelled; human video evidence uses native wall time.
